pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhaṃ sikkhamānaṃ saṃghena asammataṃ vuṭṭhāpenti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.4: etha sikkhamānā imaṃ jānātha imaṃ detha imaṃ āharatha iminā attho imaṃ kappiyaṃ karothā 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.6: na mayaṃ ayye sikkhamānā, bhikkhuniyo mayan ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhaṃ sikkhamānaṃ saṃghena asammataṃ vuṭṭhāpessantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.13: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.16: anujānāmi bhikkhave dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhāya sikkhamānāya vuṭṭhānasammutiṃ dātuṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.18: tāya dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhāya sikkhamānāya saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā . . . (LXIII.1) . . . vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc64:1.19: ahaṃ ayye itthannāmā itthannāmāya ayyāya dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhā sikkhamānā saṃghaṃ vuṭṭhānasammutiṃ yācāmīti.
